The '''30th [[Golden Globe Awards]]''', honoring the best in film and television for 1972, were held on January 28, 1973.

==Background==
[[Marlon Brando]] wished not to be nominated in any category. A survey of fifty-three countries excluding the [[United States]] found him as the most favorite actor.<ref name=Unger>{{cite news|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=bXlAAAAAIBAJ&pg=PA3&dq=%2230th+Golden+Globe+Awards%22&article_id=5998,7222213&hl|title=Why Brando refused|first=Bertil|last=Unger|newspaper=[[Glasgow Times|Evening Times]]|publisher=[[Newsquest]]|issn=0307-5745|via=[[Newspapers.com]]|date=17 February 1973|access-date=1 September 2025}}</ref>
